items.stem: An AI tool states a strong upward trend from a chart. What should the analyst do first?

options.text: Check the underlying data and whether the chart supports the claim
options.rationale: Correct: AI insights must be verified against the actual data.

options.text: Publish the insight because the AI stated it
options.rationale: AI insights can be wrong or overstated.

options.text: Assume the chart cannot be misleading
options.rationale: Charts can mislead through scale or selection.

options.text: Change the axis to make the trend look bigger
options.rationale: That would create a misleading chart.
